review_method: Opened all four full individual data/norm images with read; then opened individual source-coordinate crops to verify every missing passage below. No contact-sheet-derived labels.
coordinate_system: Original data/norm pixels, zero-based half-open [left, top, right, bottom]. Bounds are reviewed text-region rectangles, not exact glyph segmentation; they include small margins.
transcription_policy: Manual transcription from visible source pixels. Physical line-wrap hyphens are joined; punctuation and paragraph breaks retained. References are short excerpts, not full-page ground truth.

snapshot.block_indices: Zero-based positions in each snapshot page.blocks array.

stage_definitions.detection_no_candidate: Visible prose has no covering candidate in the saved snapshot.
stage_definitions.detection_geometry_gate: A partial or full candidate exists, but is_prose=false, raw_text/text empty and ocr_metrics empty; it never reached OCR. The saved 3/4-line candidates are below the five-line gate in the reviewed pipeline.
stage_definitions.ocr_classifier: Candidate was OCR-read but rejected as verse; its text survives only in diagnostics, not page.text.
stage_definitions.ocr: Accepted prose crop contains the visible glyph, but OCR omits it. Not a missing prose region.

snapshot.caution: Findings describe this saved corpus, not any later rerun. Production files were being edited independently; do not infer that the current detector hash matches the snapshot.
